overtone.about: %s by %s. Design inspired by SpotifyMusicMod (Kart-Modding, MIT).
overtone.btn.demo: Show a sample in front of me
overtone.set.hide_with_gui: Hide while a menu is open
overtone.set.duck: Mute when the game is paused
overtone.hint.default: Click — toggle / next (on a choice, the left half goes back). Double-click a slider to reset it (the white tick).
overtone.hint.widget_enabled: The “now playing” card with cover, title and progress.
overtone.hint.layout: Look of the widget: card, classic, with progress bar, compact, above the hotbar or like a vanilla tooltip.
overtone.hint.show_mode: Always on screen, or only for a few seconds when a song starts and ends.
overtone.hint.show_on_start: Show the widget for a moment when a new song starts (for timed modes).
overtone.hint.show_on_end: Show the widget shortly before the song ends (for timed modes).
overtone.hint.accent: Main color of the widget and, by default, of the player window.
overtone.picker.title: Choose a service
overtone.hint.scale: Size of the element on screen.
overtone.hint.background: How opaque the background panel is.
overtone.hint.time: Show the current time and the song length.
overtone.hint.position: Pick where it sits on the screen. Fine-tune with the offsets below.
overtone.hint.offset_x: Distance from the chosen edge, in pixels.
overtone.hint.offset_y: Distance from the chosen edge, in pixels.
overtone.hint.drag: Opens an editor over the game: drag the elements, mouse wheel changes the scale.
overtone.hint.lyrics_mode: Off, subtitles (current and next line) or karaoke (several lines scrolling).
overtone.hint.card_lyrics: Show the current line inside the widget card.
overtone.hint.word_karaoke: Highlight words one by one when the lyrics have word timings.
overtone.hint.shift: If lyrics are late, move to the minus; if they are early, move to the plus.
overtone.hint.width: Maximum width of the lyrics block.
overtone.hint.lines: How many lines karaoke shows at once.
overtone.hint.lyrics_accent: Highlight the current line with the accent color.
overtone.hint.text_shadow: Draw a shadow under the text for readability.
overtone.hint.world_enabled: Words of the song fly in the game world when they are sung. Needs lyrics with timings.
overtone.hint.world_mode: Near the player: text follows you. At the line spot: it stays where it appeared.
overtone.hint.follow: In front of your eyes, or stays in the world and does not turn with your head.
overtone.hint.word_layout: All words of a line in a row, or every word at a random spot around you.
overtone.hint.distance: How far from you the text floats. Farther looks calmer and does not block the view.
overtone.hint.height: Height relative to your eyes. Negative is lower.
overtone.hint.see_through: On: text is visible through walls. Off: walls hide it and text passes through them.
overtone.hint.demo: Shows a sample line right now so you can check the look.
overtone.hint.volume_enabled: Small popup when you change the volume with the keys.
overtone.hint.seconds: How long the popup stays on screen.
overtone.hint.percent: Show the volume as a number.
overtone.hint.sync_accent: The player window takes the widget color. Turn off to pick its own.
overtone.hint.window_size: Size of the player window. Small screens or big GUI scale limit it automatically.
overtone.hint.corner: How round the corners of the window are.
overtone.hint.tint: How much accent color is mixed into the window background.
overtone.hint.dim: How much the game behind the window is darkened.
overtone.hint.opacity: How opaque the background of the player, settings and guide windows is.
overtone.hint.cover_size: Cover art size inside the player.
overtone.hint.lyrics_in_player: Show synced lyrics inside the player window.
overtone.hint.accent_title: Paint the track title with the accent color.
overtone.hint.reset_player: Puts all player window settings back to defaults. Click twice.
overtone.hint.preview: Live preview of the player window look.
overtone.hint.key: Click, then press a key. Esc cancels, Delete clears.
overtone.hint.reset_keys: Puts all mod keys back to their defaults. Click twice.
overtone.hint.master: Turns every HUD element on or off (same as the H key).
overtone.hint.hide_with_gui: Hide the HUD while inventory or other menus are open.
overtone.hint.hide_on_tab: While Tab (player list) is held, the widget, lyrics and volume fade out.
overtone.hint.world_spread: How far from the screen centre words may appear. Lower it if you play on a narrow or stretched screen and words fall off the edge.
overtone.hint.game_volume: Music volume = slider × Master × Music from Minecraft sound options.
overtone.hint.audio_device: Where the player outputs sound. "Auto" follows Minecraft's selected output device; the list shows system audio devices.
overtone.hint.duck: Silence the music while the game window is inactive or the game is paused.
overtone.hint.prefetch: Download next tracks in advance. Great for slow internet.
overtone.hint.prefetch_count: How many tracks ahead are downloaded.
overtone.hint.disk_cache: Keep downloaded tracks on disk so repeats start instantly.
overtone.hint.clear_cache: Deletes downloaded tracks from the disk.
overtone.hint.online_lyrics: Look up lyrics on lrclib.net and the databases below. Track title, artist and duration are sent there.
overtone.hint.kugou_lyrics: Fallback source of synced lyrics. Unofficial API: title, artist and duration are sent to KuGou servers (China).
overtone.hint.amll_lyrics: AMLL TTML DB on GitHub: word-by-word karaoke highlighting. The song index is downloaded every few days; only the lyrics file name is requested.
overtone.hint.open_folder: Opens the folder where you can put your own music files.
overtone.hint.guide: Step-by-step instructions: logging in, hotkeys, troubleshooting.
overtone.hint.reset_hud: Puts every HUD setting back to defaults. Click twice.
overtone.note.world: Words of the song fly in the world when they are sung. The hotkey is in the “Keys” tab. Tracks without timed lyrics use the normal HUD text.
overtone.note.volume: The popup appears when you change the volume with the hotkeys (see the “Keys” tab).
overtone.note.keys: Keys work in the game, in the player window and in the main menu, pause and disconnect screens. They are also listed in Minecraft’s Controls menu under “Overtone”.
overtone.opt.lyricsmode.subtitle: Subtitles
overtone.picker.sub: Music keeps playing while you switch
overtone.picker.privacy: Tokens and files stay on this computer
overtone.login.paste_hint: Paste the link from the address bar here
overtone.login.sc_1: Paste your profile link (soundcloud.com/your-name) to see your likes.
overtone.login.sc_2: To like tracks too, paste an oauth_token (F12 → Application → Cookies).
overtone.login.sc_privacy: Data stays on your computer and is sent only to soundcloud.com
overtone.login.saved_sub: The token is saved on this computer — no need to paste it again.
overtone.login.forget: “x” forgets the account and deletes its token
overtone.login.ya_1: The Yandex login page opens in your browser.
overtone.login.ya_2: After logging in, copy the WHOLE link from the address bar and paste it below (Ctrl+V).
overtone.login.ya_privacy: The token is stored locally in config/musicplayer.json
overtone.player.drop: Drop a folder or files into this window
overtone.player.drop2: or put music into the folder (“Folder”) and press “Refresh”
overtone.player.drop_short: Drop a folder into the window
overtone.player.empty: Find a track or open your favorites
overtone.player.queue_hint: “+” next to a track adds it to the queue
overtone.status.no_audio_files: No supported audio files here (mp3, flac, ogg, m4a, wav), or they are already added
overtone.status.local_removed: Removed from the library: %s (the file was not deleted)
overtone.status.wave_empty: The wave has no suggestions yet
overtone.err.silent_output: the audio output is open but there is no sound (check the output device)
overtone.err.no_aac: No AAC audio in the file
overtone.err.no_frames: No audio frames in the file
overtone.err.blocked_host: Request to a disallowed address was blocked: %s
overtone.err.net_unreachable: Cannot connect to %s. The site may be blocked by your network: try a VPN or retry later.
overtone.err.file_missing: File not found: it was moved or deleted. Refresh the library.
overtone.err.not_profile: This does not look like a SoundCloud profile link
overtone.err.no_profile: There is no SoundCloud profile at this link
overtone.err.likes_need_login: Likes appear after you log in: the “Log in” button on the left
overtone.err.likes_need_token: To like tracks, add an oauth_token in the login settings
overtone.err.sc_no_stream: The track has no available stream: it is blocked by the rights holder or needs Go+
overtone.err.track_too_big: The track file is too large
overtone.err.sc_changed: Could not reach SoundCloud: the site has changed, the mod needs an update
overtone.err.wave_session: Yandex did not return a wave session
overtone.err.connection_cut: the connection dropped at %s of %s bytes
overtone.err.no_mp3: No mp3 stream (the track is unavailable or needs Plus)
overtone.err.token_invalid: The token is invalid or has no access (HTTP %s)
overtone.demo.title: Track title
overtone.demo.line.2: Set the position, style and size
overtone.demo.line.3: You see everything right away while you tune it
overtone.demo.line.6: This line is a bit longer to check how long text wraps by words
overtone.world.demo: This is how song words fly in the game, one by one, as they are sung
overtone.edit.title: HUD position
overtone.edit.help: Drag an element with the mouse. Wheel over it — scale, arrows — move by 1 pixel.
overtone.edit.hotbar: The “Above the hotbar” style is attached to the hotbar — pick another style to drag it.
overtone.edit.lyrics_off: Lyrics are off — turn them on in the “Lyrics” tab to move them.
overtone.help.quick.1.d: Press the M key in the game, or click the “♪ Overtone” button in the top-left corner of the main menu, the pause menu or the disconnect screen.
overtone.help.quick.2.d: Yandex Music needs an account. SoundCloud and “My files” work right away, no login at all.
overtone.help.quick.3.d: Type a name, press Enter and click a track. Music keeps playing after you close the window. Click an artist or an album to open it; “Play all” starts the whole album.
overtone.help.quick.4.d: Keys on the right switch tracks, pause and change the volume. You can change them in Settings → Keys.
overtone.help.yandex.1.d: Choose Yandex Music in the player and click button 1. Your browser opens the Yandex login page.
overtone.help.yandex.2.d: Sign in to your Yandex account and allow access. Afterwards the page may look empty or show an error — that is normal.
overtone.help.yandex.3.d: Click the browser address bar, press Ctrl+A, then Ctrl+C. The token is inside the link — you do not need to find it.
overtone.help.yandex.4.d: Back in Minecraft click the text field, press Ctrl+V and click button 2. Next time just pick the saved account.
overtone.help.other.1.d: Search and listening work right away. To see your likes, log in with your profile link (soundcloud.com/your-name).
overtone.help.other.2.d: To press the heart, paste your oauth_token instead of the link (browser F12 → Application → Cookies → soundcloud.com).
overtone.help.other.3.d: Drop a folder or audio files (mp3, flac, ogg, m4a, wav) into the player window, or put them into the overtone-music folder next to the game and press “Refresh”.
overtone.help.other.4.d: Lyrics load by themselves. Show them as subtitles, karaoke or flying words in the world: Settings → Lyrics / In world.
overtone.help.keys.note: Keys work in the game, in the player and in the main menu / pause / disconnect screens. Change them in Settings → Keys or in Minecraft’s Controls menu, category “Overtone”.
overtone.help.faq.1.d: Copy the address again right after you allowed access: it must contain access_token=. If it does not, open the login page again.
overtone.help.faq.2.d: Check the player’s volume slider, your system output device and Settings → General → Follow game volume (Master and Music sliders of Minecraft).
overtone.help.faq.3.d: The music keeps playing. Open the player with the “♪ Overtone” button on the disconnect screen, or press the M key.
overtone.help.faq.4.d: Move Settings → Lyrics → Lyrics shift until the words match the singing.

overtone.err.sp_no_device: No Spotify device: open the Spotify app on your PC or phone
